 "content": "def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    # Find the 4x4 placeholder region (color 3) and restore it from
    # the diametrically opposite region, rotated 180 degrees.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    rs = [r for r, c in cells]
    cs = [c for r, c in cells]
    r0, r1 = min(rs), max(rs)
    c0, c1 = min(cs), max(cs)
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    out = [[grid[n - 1 - (r0 + i)][n - 1 - (c0 + j)] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    return [row[::-1] for row in out[::-1]]
"
}
